title: Solutions Engineer Intern (Summer 2027 Opportunity)
description:
Solutions Engineer Intern - Summer 2027

Relay is a growth-stage tech company in Raleigh, NC, building the System of Action for Physical Operations. Frontline teams catch problems all day and say so over the radio. Almost none of it survives the shift. Relay captures it and turns it into action, through a rugged smart radio that works the way teams already do and a cloud platform that learns the operation, routes issues to the right people, and stays open until they're resolved. Fifteen years innovating in voice, 2 billion messages, 40+ Fortune 500 customers. Now we're expanding our Solutions Engineering team by hiring an SE intern with an expected graduation date in December 2027 or Spring 2028 to support technical pre-sales and solution delivery.

Role Overview

As a Solutions Engineer Intern, you will learn how technical expertise, customer discovery, and creative problem-solving come together during the sales process. Working alongside experienced Solutions Engineers and cross-functional partners, you will help understand customer workflows, configure and test Relay solutions, support product demonstrations and proofs of concept, and create technical resources that make our team more effective.

This internship is designed for a college student pursuing engineering, computer science, information systems, data science, or another applicable technical field. You will receive mentorship, structured learning opportunities, and ownership of meaningful work—without being expected to independently lead enterprise technical sales cycles.

What Makes Our Intern Program Different

Executive exposure through Q&A sessions, coffee chats, and working sessions with senior leaders.
A cross-functional intern cohort with opportunities to learn alongside interns across the business.
Structured learning sessions covering product strategy, professional networking, communication, interviewing, and other career-building skills.
Real ownership of a meaningful project, supported by mentors and teammates invested in your success.
An end-of-summer intern showcase where you can present your work to the company.
An in-person Raleigh HQ experience with team lunches, volunteer opportunities, social events, and access to onsite amenities.

What You Will Do

Learn Customer Discovery and Solution Design

Shadow customer discovery sessions and help document operational pain points, workflows, and technical requirements.
Partner with Solutions Engineers to translate customer needs into practical Relay configurations and solution diagrams.
Learn how Relay’s platform, APIs, integrations, and device capabilities support frontline operations

Support Demos and Proofs of Concept

Research and organize technical information that supports customer questions, security reviews, RFIs/RFPs, and IT architecture discussions.
Practice explaining technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.

Create Documentation and Enablement

Document solution configurations, architecture decisions, API usage, testing results, and implementation considerations.
Create reusable assets such as diagrams, one-pagers, demo guides, checklists, and troubleshooting resources.
Help prepare clear handoff materials for Customer Success and Implementation teams.

Complete an Intern Project

Own a scoped summer project that improves a Solutions Engineering process, demo, prototype, integration, or enablement resource.
Present your work, findings, and recommendations to Solutions Engineering leaders and cross-functional partners at the end of the internship

Required Qualifications

What You Will Bring:

Currently pursuing a bachelor’s or master’s degree in engineering, computer science, information systems, data science, or another applicable technical field.
Expected graduation date of December 2027 or Spring 2028.
A strong academic record; a cumulative GPA of 3.5 or above is preferred.
Relevant technical experience gained through coursework, labs, research, internships, student organizations, hackathons, or personal projects.
Foundational understanding of software, systems, networking, cloud technology, data, or connected devices—and an eagerness to deepen that knowledge.
Some familiarity with APIs, JSON, scripting, or application integrations through coursework or projects; deep professional experience is not required.
Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to ask thoughtful questions and explain ideas clearly.
Curiosity about customer problems and enthusiasm for learning how technology can improve real-world operations.
A collaborative, dependable approach and comfort receiving feedback, iterating, and learning from others.
Ability to work full-time onsite at Relay’s Raleigh, NC headquarters for the duration of the summer internship.

Nice To Have

Exposure to technical presentations, demonstrations, consulting, sales engineering, customer service,or other customer-facing work.
Experience with REST APIs, Postman, Python, JavaScript, data visualization, networking, or cloud platforms.
Interest in frontline operations, manufacturing, logistics, hospitality, industrial technology, IoT, or automation.
Experience building or explaining a technical project to an audience through a class, club, competition, internship, or personal project.

We use AI tools to transcribe and summarize interviews for internal hiring purposes. Transcripts are accessible only to authorized hiring personnel and retained consistent with our data retention policies. Candidates who prefer not to have AI notetaking used may request to opt out without impact to your candidacy. For more information, please see our Candidate and Employee Privacy Notice linked here.
